market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from rising yields and energy inflation. Expect volatility as Fed hike digests. Chip sector may consolidate. Sentiment at 16-month low suggests near-term weakness but potential for relief rallies. Earnings season (Q3) will be the key swing factor per UBS.
market_outlook.long_term: AI infrastructure capex cycle, data center buildout, and energy transition support structural growth. Rate normalization may peak within 6-9 months. Buffett succession signals institutional continuity. US-China tensions remain wildcard. Dividend and quality strategies outperform in this regime.
